mapper.insert:
insert into vqms_runtime_stats (stat_grain, stat_period, entity_id, in_service_min, exit_grid_min, exit_nongrid_min, offline_min, rated_capacity_kw, rate_pct, shortfall_pct, penalty_score, recompute_at) values
(#{r.statGrain}, #{r.statPeriod}, #{r.entityId}, #{r.inServiceMin}, #{r.exitGridMin}, #{r.exitNonGridMin}, #{r.offlineMin}, #{r.ratedCapacityKw}, #{r.ratePct}, #{r.shortfallPct}, #{r.penaltyScore}, sysdate())
on duplicate key update in_service_min = values(in_service_min), exit_grid_min = values(exit_grid_min), exit_nongrid_min = values(exit_nongrid_min), offline_min = values(offline_min), rated_capacity_kw = values(rated_capacity_kw), rate_pct = values(rate_pct), shortfall_pct = values(shortfall_pct), penalty_score = values(penalty_score), recompute_at = values(recompute_at)
mapper.select: select id, stat_grain, stat_period, entity_id, in_service_min, exit_grid_min, exit_nongrid_min, offline_min, rated_capacity_kw, rate_pct, shortfall_pct, penalty_score, recompute_at from vqms_runtime_stats where stat_grain = #{grain} and stat_period >= #{start} and stat_period <= #{end} order by stat_period
